hook: Holy Sh\*t 😱 DeepSeek just announced *Creator Mode*. Their AI agent now turns your ideas into plugins
caption:
DeepSeek just introduced Creator Mode in DeepSeek Harness, its open-source agent runtime.
You describe an idea and turn it into a plugin you can actually use. DeepSeek's own examples: a design workspace, a sandbox game and a 3D LLM visualizer.
Harness first launched as an MIT-licensed developer preview in August.

What would you build with it?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.
